items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: when you’ve got Pete Christlieb or Plas Johnson or Bob Efford sitting there... I had a big band in L.A.

ctx.x: I’d like to think that that’s important, that you’re still connected in a physical way to the players who are making your music come alive, and you still know what that feels like.

Oh I’m always conscious of it, particularly, you know the interesting thing, somebody said, “Why don’t you feature yourself more with your big band?” And I said, “Because there are five saxophone players who are better than me and I want to hear them.” You know I don’t mind playing three numbers in the whole show, you know that’s fine as long as I can hear some of these brilliant players. And I had a big band in L.A. and a big band in Australia and one is the U.K. and they’re all fantastic. You know when you’ve…
Well I suspect you’re running out of room in your house for the mementos and awards and all that.
